_comment: Findings already reported, so the daily routine does not raise them again. Seeded by the first run on 2026-10-31, which reviewed every dimension at once; normal runs cover one dimension a day.

reported.summary: pipeline/uds.py sum_labelled returns a total built from whichever of the male/female columns is present, so a blank column publishes a halved patient count as a reported HRSA figure
pipeline/uds.py total_from_coded_lines takes any line equal to half the sum as the total, so two equal components with no total row publish one component as the count
pipeline/uds.py _stream_sheet tests looks_like_descriptions without the looks_like_data_row veto that sheet_headers applies, so the first health center on a sheet can be eaten as a header row
pipeline/website.py searches range(index, index+2) for an email, so a person is given the address printed on the following person's line and it reaches the outreach list
README documents data/suppression.txt but config.resolve puts it at the project root, so opt-outs placed where the README says are silently not honoured and no warning is printed

app/roles.py matches \badministrator\b as CHIEF_EXECUTIVE and tests it before TECHNOLOGY, so IT/Systems Administrator and Board President are reported as the CEO; app/roles.py has no test asserting any classify() outcome

app/queries.py hard-codes role_kind=CHIEF_EXECUTIVE on the UDS project-director row, so a CFO who happens to be the HRSA contact is exported in the Chief executive role (the title precedence itself is deliberate and documented)
pipeline/website.py _TITLE_PATTERN word group is bounded on the left only, so surnames beginning with a role word (Boardman, Chairez, Chiefley) are rejected as titles and those people are dropped

pipeline/text.py normalize_state returns text[:2], so a source that spells the state out turns Arizona into AR and Mississippi into MI, breaking dedup keys, the footprint filter and state-match EIN scoring

pipeline/changes.py uses `share = delta/previous if previous else 0` then renders {share:.0%}, producing 'up 0% from $0'; the UI layer already returns None for this case with a test saying dividing by zero is not infinite growth
app/queries.py prints 'IRS classification: 501(c)(3) public charity' whenever a confirmed EIN has any filing; no subsection code is read anywhere in the codebase

app/models.py Grant.is_active compares a midnight-UTC end date against now, so an award reports as ended for the whole of its final day; pipeline/grants.py DATE_FORMATS entry '%d %b %Y' is also unreachable because the value is split on space first
pipeline/irs.py _persist_profile and _persist_programs are entirely uncovered; the parse is tested and the render is tested, but the write path between them is not

README says twelve profile sections (template has thirteen, Grants awarded missing), says the end-to-end test runs five stages (nine), and says nothing is hard-coded while scoring.py MINIMUM_SITES_SCORE=60 has no config key; the website stage reports a bland zero the README says it will not
